summary: Research Alliance Corp IV filed an 8-K on July 10, 2026, reporting the effectiveness of its S-1 registration statement for its initial public offering (IPO) of Class A ordinary shares. The filing details the entry into standard IPO agreements: an underwriting agreement with Leerink Partners as the sole bookrunner, an investment management trust agreement, a registration rights agreement with the sponsor, indemnity agreements for officers and directors, and a letter agreement concerning sponsor and insider commitments. The registrant is a blank-check company conducting a de-SPAC IPO; no business combination or other special-situation event is announced. The filing is a routine current report of an IPO effectiveness and associated ancillary agreements, not a special situation as defined.
